user.title: Household Expenses
user.description: No input is required for the initial setup — just submit to finish.

abort.already_configured: Household Expenses is already set up. Use "Configure" to add, edit or delete items.

init.title: Household Expenses
init.description: Add, edit or remove expense items. Changes take effect when you press “Finish and save” (the closing step required by Home Assistant).

add.title: Add item
add.description: Pick the expense type; the following steps ask for its parameters.

add_name.title: Item name
add_name.description: You can add several items of the same type (e.g. two mortgages); names must be unique.

edit_menu.title: Edit item
edit_menu.description: Pick what to change; every change takes effect immediately.

periods.title: Periods and amounts
periods.description: Add as many periods as you need, e.g. when the monthly amount changes after a rate adjustment.

period_add.title: Add period
period_add.description: Enter the period and its amount. Tick “add another period” to keep going, otherwise continue to the next step.

data.more: Add another period (when the amount changes)

data_description.end: Leave empty for ongoing (no end date).
data_description.amount_repay: Amount repaid per month within this period.
data_description.amount_rent: Rent paid per month within this period.
data_description.amount_sublet: Rent received per month within this period.
data_description.amount_property: Property fee per month within this period.
data_description.amount_heating: Total heating fee for this period, spread over its days.
data_description.more: Shows this form again so you can append the next period (e.g. after a rate change).

data_description.end: Leave empty for ongoing (no end date).
data_description.amount_repay: Amount repaid per month within this period.
data_description.amount_rent: Rent paid per month within this period.
data_description.amount_sublet: Rent received per month within this period.
data_description.amount_property: Property fee per month within this period.
data_description.amount_heating: Total heating fee for this period, spread over its days.

extra.title: Other parameters
extra.description: Parameters differ per expense type: loans have down payment, loan term, outstanding principal and repayment day; rent/parking have an agency or custody fee; property fee has a paid-until month; heating fee has a remaining amount.

data_description.upfront: Down payment, amortised over the loan term.
data_description.repay_day: Day of the month, e.g. 21. Shorter months use their last day.
data_description.balance_date: The date this outstanding principal was read; every repayment day after it deducts one instalment automatically.
data_description.agency_fee: Agency fee, amortised over the period.
data_description.custody_fee: Custody fee, amortised over the period.
data_description.heating_remaining: How much is left for this heating season. The sensor shows this number as-is, without any conversion. Leave empty for 0.

delete_confirm.title: Confirm deletion
delete_confirm.description: The entity and its snapshot will be removed. Continue?

error.end_before_start: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
error.name_exists: This name already exists, please pick another one.
error.invalid_month: The month must be in YYYY-MM format, e.g. 2026-10.
error.last_period: At least one period must be kept.
error.invalid_date: Invalid date, please select a valid date.
